content.title: Stock Movement | BYD Co., Ltd. (01211) rose nearly 5% intraday as the company's overseas expansion gains strong momentum; its sub-brand Tengshi’s fast-charging new model enters the European market.
content.text: BYD (01211) surged nearly 5% during the trading session. As of the latest update, it rose by 4.47%, trading at HKD 109.8, with a transaction volume of HKD 2.56 billion. According to Zhitong Finance APP, BYD (01211) rose nearly 5% during the trading session. As of the time of writing, it increased by 4.47%, trading at HKD 109.8 with a turnover of HKD 2.56 billion.In terms of news, BYD's overseas sales of new energy vehicles in March this year exceeded 120,000 units, representing a year-on-year growth of 65.12%, reaching a new high for the year. In the first quarter of this year, overseas cumulative sales reached 320,000 units, accounting for nearly 46% of total sales. Notably, on April 8 local time, BYD's luxury brand Tengshi held its European launch event at the Paris Opera House in France. The flagship models Z9GT and D9 were officially unveiled, with a starting price of approximately EUR 115,000 (equivalent to over CNY 900,000), marking a new milestone in Tengshi's global strategy. Another key highlight of the launch event was the flash charging technology based on BYD’s second-generation blade battery, with a maximum charging power of 1500kW.Guosheng Securities stated that the company is actively promoting the layout of overseas markets, and export contributions continue to rise. The launch of flash charging models is expected to boost domestic sales. Guolian Minsheng Securities noted that recently, international crude oil prices have remained volatile at high levels, significantly amplifying the lifecycle cost advantages of new energy vehicles in overseas markets. The global competitiveness of China’s new energy products has become even more prominent.
